objective: Extend the DR24 Explorer browser smoke to four pinned OIDs and test that missing catflags are displayed as unknown, not clean.
previous_knowledge_consumed: PR #267 adds a raw-only DR24 Explorer that preserves HMJD, native photometry and catflags.
PR #270 verified FastAPI-to-HATS payload parity for three OIDs (417 epochs).
PR #259 verified a fourth OID payload as part of a four-OID HATS sample; its catalog nepochs matched 209 returned epochs.
The previous browser smoke verified three OIDs, 417 epochs, missing-OID behavior and source-failure behavior.
Missing catflags must not be interpreted as catflags=0.

baseline.description: Test-only branch based on the Workbench implementation. No model, feature, taxonomy, benchmark, or release changes.

correctness.before: The browser smoke covered three OIDs and did not test missing catflags.
correctness.after: The browser test now covers four OIDs (626 expected epochs) and includes a synthetic null-catflags case. Live execution is pending.

reproducibility.after: The expanded test compares four per-OID payload hashes and records raw-source provenance. Live execution is pending.

scientific_validity.reason: The browser view remains raw-only. It does not validate astrophysical identity, photometric normalization, feature generation, inference, calibration, OOD, or anomaly performance.

measurement.trade_off: Use four independently pinned OIDs. The fourth OID comes from the previously verified four-OID payload artifact. No additional source acquisition is required for this test revision.

evidence: Existing browser run 42073257588 passed for three OIDs and 417 epochs.

The independent HATS payload artifact from run 41674212725 contains four OIDs and 626 epochs; OID 278215200018105 has 209 epochs and canonical SHA-256 8fc2f95b389cb9cca129538f647dc83a1cf3b82cde37635a90f2d35ad9c596b8.
The new test adds a null-catflags UI fixture. It must render in a neutral unknown state, not as a clean epoch.
The new branch must pass the live browser workflow before this cycle can be marked verified.

root_causes: A prior rerun on ubuntu-latest failed before tests because Playwright 1.56 does not support the Ubuntu 26.04 runner image. The workflow is now pinned to ubuntu-24.04.
unresolved: The four-OID browser rerun is pending.
A 5–10 object application acceptance test with source selection, QC, exports and a reproducibility bundle remains open.
The raw-only path does not validate feature generation or inference.

findings: A null catflags value is unknown quality metadata and must not be colored as unflagged.
Bit 15 remains visible; this UI does not filter epochs.
The browser test must verify the exact API payload and its displayed representation.

open_blockers: Run the four-OID browser test on the supported Ubuntu runner.
Then build the separate 5–10 object application smoke with a valid source/identity/QC contract.
Then complete the 30–50 object guided Park demonstration.

knowledge_carried_forward: Keep the DR24 Explorer raw-only and separate from frozen v0.2.0 inference.
Do not filter catflags or relabel HMJD.
Unknown catflags are not equivalent to zero or clean.
Do not claim Park MVP acceptance from this browser smoke.
